standard_prerequisites.name: The fraction fields of the base and of the local rings of the source agree
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The observations following the vanishing situation, describing the source as a modification of the spectrum of the base and the relation between the function fields
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows writing elements of the maximal ideal of a local ring of the source as fractions of elements of the base.

standard_prerequisites.name: Choice of a closed point of one component outside the others
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The observation that the components of the special fibre are pairwise distinct closed curves, so that a closed point of one of them can be chosen avoiding the others
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the points at which the factorization of the constructed function is required.

core_obligations: Choose the points and local elements (proof lines 1626-1636): for each component of the special fibre choose a closed point lying on that component and on no other, and choose an element of the maximal ideal of the local ring at that point whose image in the local ring of the component is nonzero.

Produce a global function (proof lines 1636-1641): each of the chosen local elements can be written as a quotient of two elements of the base because the fraction fields agree, and the product of the numerators is a nonzero element of the maximal ideal of the base which factors as required at each of the chosen points.
proof_roadmap: Pick points of the components avoiding the other components.
Pick local functions cutting out the components at those points.
Multiply the numerators of the local expressions to get the global function.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the existence of a nonzero element of the maximal ideal of the base whose localizations at suitably chosen points of the components of the special fibre factor with a factor cutting out the corresponding component (statement lines 1622-1632). The proof (proof lines 1633-1641) chooses points and local elements and multiplies the numerators of their expressions as fractions of elements of the base. H2: a complete short construction.
